name: ipymuvue
description: Reactive Jupyter Widgets (ipymuvue-implementation repackaged for Jupyter Notebooks, JupyterLab, …)
author: Julian Rüth

scripts.build:lib: cd ../ts && yarn install --frozen-lockfile && yarn run build
scripts.build:lib:prod: cd ../ts && yarn install --frozen-lockfile && yarn run build:prod
scripts.build: yarn run build:lib && jupyter labextension build --development True .
scripts.build:prod: yarn run clean && yarn run build:lib:prod && jupyter labextension build .
